title: Joshikousei no Houkago... Pukunpa
native_title: 女子高生の放課後… ぷくんパ
overview:
A pretty-girl falling-block puzzle from Athena

The two small balls spin round and round too. Make lots of chains, okay? Two-player battles are OK too.

Pukunpa is a falling-block puzzle game starring high school girls dressed for their after-school clubs. Pairs of colored blocks drop into the field, and linking three or more of one color clears them. The twist is the bubble: one block in a pair is often a bubble holding two more blocks that you can rotate inside it. Clear the blocks beside a bubble and its contents burst out to set up bigger chains, which bury your opponent under obstacle blocks.

- Vs mode against a string of computer rivals or a friend
- Endless mode for clearing as many blocks as you can
- Switch to Funny Mode for a cast of cartoon characters
- High scores and settings saved to memory backup

アテナが贈る、美少女落ちものパズル

いっぱい連鎖してね
